newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-J.Singleton to equal or better 95/96.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-J.Singleton to equal or better 95/96.

text.p: John Singleton Advertising Ltd said on Friday it was confident it could equal or better the 1995/96 profit in the current year ending June 30, 1997.

"Although we continue to operate in very tough market conditions, I am confident the agency will achieve results equal to or better than 1995/96," chairman Bill Currie told shareholders at the annual meeting.
"The first quarter performance of the advertising agency has been solid," Currie said. The advertising group reported a seven percent rise in net profit to A$6.26 million in 1995/96.
